siteProfile.applicationDescription: Tips for Your Gifts helps shoppers choose thoughtful gifts by explaining what a product is, how it fits the recipient's real life, what they may already own, and what a specialty addition contributes. Recommendations are researched and ranked without regard to commission.
siteProfile.audienceClaim: No audience-size, traffic, conversion, or revenue claim is made until a complete aggregate measurement baseline exists.
siteProfile.sensitiveDataPolicy: Account credentials, legal identity, tax details, payout details, and private contact information are entered only in the partner portal by Lucas and are never stored in Git.

programs.applicationPositioning: Lead with the reviewed book anchors and the publication's independent, explanation-first editorial approach. Do not imply that Bookshop covers the non-book companion products.
specialRequirements: Bookshop must verify the external account before any tracking identity is recorded.
Only the ten explicitly scoped book products may enter exact-link review during the narrow pilot.
stopConditions: Stop if the portal requests a claim about traffic, revenue, or first-hand product testing that the publication cannot substantiate.
Stop if the exact edition or Bookshop-issued paid destination cannot be independently verified.

programs.applicationPositioning: Describe the owned editorial website and its commission-independent rankings. Do not promise broad coverage until exact products and Amazon-issued Special Links are verified one at a time.
specialRequirements: The current operating agreement and incorporated program policies require a fresh founder review before signup.
Only program-provided link formats may enter the exact-link lane after account acceptance.
stopConditions: Stop if a requested content, pricing, or availability claim cannot be supported by an authorized current source.
Stop if enrollment would require changing editorial rankings or removing ordinary manufacturer fallbacks.

programs.applicationPositioning: Position Target as a possible exact-product retailer alternative for family-friendly shopping, never as a substitute for the editorially selected product.
specialRequirements: The operative member agreement must be retrieved from the partner portal and reviewed before acceptance.
Marketplace substitutions and near matches cannot be represented as the reviewed product.
stopConditions: Stop if the operative member contract is unavailable for complete founder review before acceptance.
Stop if the partner portal cannot produce an exact-product destination with a stable disclosure path.

programs.applicationPositioning: Describe the owned publication and its practical gift coverage without claiming an active social audience or creator performance that has not been measured.
specialRequirements: Lucas must confirm applicant eligibility, select a truthful public social account, and review the current arbitration and disclosure terms.
Member-only payout terms and Impact identity verification remain separate from editorial approval.
stopConditions: Stop if the application would require presenting a dormant or unrelated social account as an active publication channel.
Stop if required disclosure, exact-product eligibility, or member payout terms cannot be captured for review.

programs.applicationPositioning: Position eBay only as a contingency for exact discontinued or hard-to-find products. Stable manufacturer or specialist destinations remain preferred.
specialRequirements: Written eBay approval for promotion through generative-AI tools is required before this AI-assisted publication may activate EPN.
Every volatile listing needs a fresh seller, condition, shipping, and exact-item check.
stopConditions: Stop until eBay grants the required written AI-tools approval from the registered account.
Stop if a volatile listing would be presented as a stable canonical product destination.
